semanticProof.purpose: Prove direct operation use and independent outcome-guidance use without inherited Console, HTTP, or MCP syntax.
semanticProof.authorityBoundary: JTest owns the operation and capability semantics. Program Kit validates projection, binding, closure, and evidence only.

fixtures.expected: Console and OpenAPI exposure bindings reference the same exact application-owned operation and contract revisions without requiring equal syntax.
Two host bindings cannot share one operation identity merely because they call one handler; absent application-owner equivalence blocks.
Every selected operation appears exactly once with exact schemas, diagnostics, authority, effects, timeout, cancellation, concurrency, idempotency, compatibility, and migration facts when present.
Missing application facts remain absent or blocking; Program Kit does not infer summaries, effects, workflow meaning, results, or remediation.
The reserved full option returns one BOM-free JSON document plus newline containing the complete operation array and deduplicated transitive schema closure.
The selected option accepts one exact operation revision and returns the same shape restricted to that operation.
An application command or alias cannot claim the reserved option; mixed, duplicated, spaced, unknown, or extra arguments fail before application dispatch.
Introspection composes no application services, performs no reflection/configuration/network access, and exposes no secrets.
MCP 2026-07-28 server/discover and per-request metadata negotiate successfully; tools/list is deterministic and tools/call returns the exact application result.
MCP 2025-11-25 initialize, tools/list, and tools/call succeed over the same bridge and portable object-root schema profile.
Protocol era is selected on the wire; a startup --protocol option is rejected as unsupported.
Scope/name normalization, 128-character truncation/hash behavior, operation metadata, and duplicate refusal are deterministic.
One exact operation resolves to one selected invocation adapter in a registration; Console/API ambiguity blocks until the human selects.
A fresh provider session can discover and invoke the exact JTest operation through MCP without an initialized JTest capability.
Success and application diagnostics remain application-owned; protocol, execution, conformance, and application failures remain distinct; no Program Kit result envelope or retry appears.
Exact bytes, schema, timeout, cancellation, concurrency, idempotency, resource policy, fresh process, stderr/stdout, and no-autonomy conformance pass.
Codex and Claude Code project-entry proposals are deterministic and no provider bytes change without the exact accepted proposal digest.
Registration starts no provider, bridge, consumer, or tool and grants no trust or permission.
Unowned, changed, missing, reserved, or colliding provider/server/tool state rejects without adoption or partial mutation.
Status is read-only; changed operation/tool bytes require explicit update; remove touches only the exact owned entry and lock.
Exact local, NuGet, HTTPS, and GitHub-release acquisitions normalize into identical content identity when logical bundle bytes are identical.
Latest, ranges, ambiguous assets, missing expected HTTPS digest, query-string secrets, authenticated/private source assumptions, and implicit format detection reject.
After acquisition, verify, initialize, status, preflight, and reads use only stored exact bytes and never re-resolve the original source.
Evidence separately records publisher-official content and Program Kit integrity/compatibility/completeness without semantic endorsement.
A capability local binding resolves to exact operation, request, result, and diagnostic revisions while containing no Console path, HTTP route, or MCP tool name.
Multi-operation and meaningful one-operation capabilities conform; unreferenced operations are reported but do not force one capability per operation.
All operation descriptions, transitive schemas, examples/templates, diagnostics/remediation, interpretations, packages, migrations, and required materializers are installed and digest-valid.
Removing or changing each required closure class independently blocks agent-guided preflight before execution with the missing exact identity.
Incomplete closure cannot be repaired through source checkout, source grep, assembly inspection, undeclared fixtures, remembered knowledge, or network retrieval.
Resolved handoffs are acyclic; required dependencies block when missing; optional handoffs do not; no handoff invokes or transfers authority automatically.
One exact bundle/provider proposal resolves required tool bindings and renders wrappers; mutation requires its own accepted digest independent of tool registration.
Accepted per-bundle/provider locks project one byte-identical flat workspace catalog grouped by publisher and application with no nested index or score.
Manual catalog or provider-wrapper edit is detectable drift and blocks reads; an accepted refresh reconstructs canonical derived bytes from the same verified bundle.
Same-bundle projection changes require refresh; changed bundle version/digest requires update; refresh never blesses new authoritative bytes.
A tampered ownership lock cannot be used as refresh source and requires explicit verified ownership recovery.
The Program Kit meta capability reads only the flat catalog and explains available outcomes, direct operations, and setup blockers without routing scores or automatic activation.

A source-free cold semantic JTest request selects the official outcome capability, requests missing human decisions, resolves exact registered operation bindings, and reports the application-defined outcome or blocker without inherited syntax.
Codex and Claude Code use their native capability/tool selection and permission mechanisms; observations remain provider-labelled and no Program Kit confidence router or permission grant appears.
A clean workspace uses Program Kit's package-owned consumer payload to discover, preflight, and complete a representative supported outcome without Program Kit source or internal knowledge.

Every supported Program Kit consumer operation is directly discoverable and schema-backed; every genuine multi-operation consumer outcome has complete guidance without imposing one capability per command.
No self-registration, self-initialization, self-permission, automatic provider start, automatic handoff, retry loop, nested tool loop, or application-runtime workspace mutation exists.
Material MCP, Codex, Claude Code, Open Console, OpenAPI, operation, or capability contract drift blocks the affected work unit or transition for review.

closurePolicy: Every fixture is required. Deterministic fixtures cannot replace genuine provider evidence. Provider-neutral equality does not assert prompt, model, reasoning, or general behavioral equivalence.
